7797.description_text: ✔️CARDIOVASCULAR SUPPORT. Nattokinase is a powerful enzyme extracted from traditional Japanese Natto - soybeans that have been fermented with Bacillus subtilis. Natto has been consumed by the Japanese for over 1,000 years for its delicious taste. Much more than a simple food, natto is eaten for its various nutritional benefits. This may be one of the reasons why the Japanese have greater longevity and better cardiovascular health than other populations. Following the discovery of nattokinase, many studies evaluated the health effects of supplementation with this enzyme. 7839.name_original: Phytoceramides – Clinically Proven Lipowheat® – Anti-Ageing Skin Support
7839.description_text: WHAT ARE PHYTOCERAMIDES? Phytoceramides are part of the ceramide family which are present in all cell membranes. In the skin, ceramides guarantee cell cohesion and ensure the integrity of the epidermis. They play a key role in hydrating the skin. In the dermis, the ceramides stimulate the cell activity and promote the synthesis of collagen naturally present in the skin. This dual-activity in the epidermis and dermis, helps to reduce visible signs of ageing such as wrinkles and lines. ✔️LIPOWHEAT® PROVIDES ADVANCED ANTI-AGEING SUPPORT FOR SKIN BY RESTORING VITAL MECHANISMS. Intrinsic ageing is characterised by three features: Dermal atrophy due to collagen loss, degeneration in the elastic fibre network, and loss of hydration. Lipowheat® restores skin youthfulness naturally by: Inhibiting collagenase and elastase activity, increasing collagen synthesis, visibly reducing wrinkles and improving overall appearance of skin. By restoring healthy biological mechanisms, Lipowheat® improves skin smoothness and radiance while reducing the appearance of wrinkles. ✔️CLINICALLY PROVEN FORMULA. Double-blinded, placebo controlled clinical trials have been performed on Lipowheat. These have demonstrated the strong hydrating properties of Lipowheat as well as its anti-ageing effect in reducing wrinkles and on the homogeneity and radiance of the skin (see images). ✔️GLUTEN FREE. Lipowheat™ is extracted from wheat grain using gentle methods which preserve the quality of its precious lipids, the phytoceramides. These processes guarantee the absence of gluten. This unique marine multimineral complex provides 72 trace minerals in addition to calcium, delivered in forms your body naturally recognizes. **Magnesium** Sourced directly from the mineral-rich Dead Sea, this complete magnesium complex contains all 5 natural forms: oxide, hydroxide, sulfate, carbonate and chloride. Whether you're concerned about bone density, seeking to support an active lifestyle, or simply want to maintain healthy bones as you age, this powerful duo works synergistically to provide complete mineral support. Bone Aid delivers essential calcium with its crucial cofactors, while Magnesium complements the formula with five natural forms of this vital mineral. **THE SCIENCE:** Advanced plant and mineral-based formulations supported by research: - **Calcium, Vitamin D3 & K2 Synergy:** Research shows that these three nutrients work together synergistically for optimal bone health. Vitamin D3 enhances calcium absorption from the digestive tract, while vitamin K2 activates specific proteins that help direct calcium to the bones where it's needed. Studies demonstrate that this combination is more effective than calcium alone for supporting bone mineral density. - **Magnesium's Role in Bone Health:** Clinical research has established that magnesium is essential for bone health through multiple mechanisms. It helps activate vitamin D, regulates calcium transport, and contributes to bone crystal formation. Studies show that higher magnesium intake is associated with increased bone mineral density, particularly important as we age. - **Marine Minerals Complex:** Research indicates that plant-sourced calcium from marine algae has superior bioavailability compared to standard calcium supplements. The natural co-factors present in the seaweed matrix enhance mineral absorption and utilization by the body. **WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS SAY:** Bone Aid: - *"Small, easy to swallow, don't make me feel nauseous like other vitamins and I have felt a huge improvement in such a short time."* - Jane - *"My bone density has not only stabilised but improved at my last dexa scan"* - Amanda Catt - *"I have been taking Bone Aid for some years now and at aged 88 years I do not have any pains at all. It definitely works for me"* - Wendy Markham YOUR COMPLETE DAILY ROUTINE: **MORNING** * 2 Bone Aid capsules **AFTERNOON** * 1 Magnesium capsule **KEY POINTS:** * Can be taken with or without food * Try to take at consistent times each day * Can be taken all together in the morning, but spacing as suggested optimises benefits **WHAT TO EXPECT:** Within 6-12 months of starting Bone Complete™, you may notice: - Maintenance of bone health and support for bone density, as part of a healthy diet and lifestyle - Gradual improvement in overall bone strength - Continued support for maintaining good posture and bone integrity Note: Bone health improvements occur gradually over time and depend on multiple factors. The most reliable way to track progress is through regular bone density scans as recommended by your healthcare provider. **PERFECT FOR:** - Adults looking to support bone health naturally - People over 50 concerned about bone density - Those with limited dairy intake - Athletes and active individuals - Those wanting an alternative to synthetic supplements

That's why we've crafted our Seaweed Calcium tablets, a superior, naturally effective calcium supplement that stands out in the market. Why Choose Our Seaweed Calcium? 100% Vegan and Clean: Our calcium tablets are ideal for those following a vegan lifestyle, ensuring you get your daily calcium intake without any animal-derived ingredients. Highly Absorbed, Plant-Based Calcium: Sourced from pristine Atlantic seawater, our seaweed calcium is natural and highly bioavailable, making it easy for your body to absorb and utilise. Rich in Trace Minerals: Unlike regular calcium supplements, our seaweed-derived formula includes an impressive profile of 72 ionic trace minerals, enhancing overall nutrient absorption and effectiveness. Gentle on the Stomach: Formulated to be kind to your body, our calcium tablets are gentle on the stomach, making them suitable for daily consumption without discomfort. Scientifically Backed: We pride ourselves on offering products that are not only naturally effective but also scientifically proven, ensuring you receive the optimum level of goodness in every dose. Ideal for Bone and Teeth Health Whether you're looking to support your bone density, improve dental health, or simply ensure you're getting enough calcium in your diet, Together Health's Seaweed Calcium is your go-to choice. It's especially beneficial for women, vegans, and those with osteoporosis. Calcium carbonate vs calcium citrate Most supplements use one of two forms of calcium—carbonate or citrate. Traditionally, carbonate is extracted from inorganic rock sources, while citrate is synthetically made. When comparing these forms, citrate is recommended for its superior absorption. However, when you choose a plant-based source of calcium, these comparisons become meaningless. With natural sources of minerals, the issue of "form" becomes far less significant as they are all well-absorbed due to fundamental differences between inorganic and synthetic forms. For example, calcified seaweeds, like the source of our calcium, combine calcium from ocean water - calcium ions - with carbonate ions also in the water. This creates a plant-based form of calcium carbonate that they use to create their skeletal structures. Here, the calcium carbonate is naturally created and integrated into the very cells of the seaweed, bound to trace minerals the seaweed also requires in a unique cellular architecture completely different from inorganic sources like chalk or limestone. Plus, the additional trace minerals the plant structure doesn't contain—such as magnesium, strontium, and silica- contribute to the efficient absorption of calcium in your body and work synergistically for overall bone health. This natural complexity is something a synthetic form, such as calcium citrate, could never replicate. So, when choosing natural sources for your calcium, you can be confident your body absorbs and utilises them in ways no synthetic form could ever offer. Environmentally Conscious Packaging Committed to sustainability, our calcium supplements come in environmentally-friendly packaging, aligning with your values and ours. Easy to Take Our calcium tablets are convenient to incorporate into your daily routine. Just two capsules a day can significantly contribute to your calcium needs. Made in the UK Every Together product is made right here in the UK. It’s the only way we can guarantee the absolute highest quality and provide the best of British Supplements. But when it comes to finding the best ingredients, we go far and wide, from traditionally-grown herbs in rural India to US labs pioneering contamination-free algae. All these wonderful ingredients are then third-party tested in the UK, before ending up in your products. Join the Together Health Community Experience the difference with Together Health's Seaweed Calcium. It's not just a supplement; it's a commitment to your health backed by nature and science. 7939.description_text: Fenugreek is a clover-like herb from the Fabaceae family, also known as Trigonella foenum-graecum. The leaves and seeds of fenugreek are commonly used in cooking to provide aroma and flavour. The plant is native to southern Europe and the Mediterranean region but is also grown in northern Africa and western Asia. Viridian Fenugreek Extract is taken from the seed and standardised to the key active saponins. One capsule provides the equivalent of 4800mg of whole herb and provides 300mg of saponins. Fenugreek is rich in bioactive compounds called phytonutrients, which are naturally produced within the plant. This spice is specially sourced from growers for its optimal potency and sustainable crop cultivation. The biodiverse process facilitates the replantation of harvested ingredients. Fenugreek can support a variety of areas including maintenance of normal blood glucose and the control of lipid metabolism. It is also known as a galactagogue, meaning it can support milk production and recovery after childbirth. Viridian Fenugreek Extract has a unique blend of high potency Fenugreek and Zinc, which contributes to the maintenance of normal testosterone levels in the blood. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 7942.description_text: A unique blend of Myo-Inositol and Folic Acid, in a pleasant tasting powder. Folate is an important B vitamin which contributes to maternal tissue growth during pregnancy. This supplement from Viridian provides optimal levels of both nutrients in the right combination.Myo-Inositol belongs to the B complex family of vitamins (sometimes referred to as vitamin B8). The body can make myo-inositol from glucose and it is also found naturally in foods such as organ meats, fruits, grains, nuts and beans. Meanwhile, folic acid has been shown to help reduce feelings of tiredness and fatigue as well as supporting the function of the immune system and playing an important role in cell formation. Each serving delivers 200μg of folic acid. This water-soluble vitamin cannot be stored by the body, and so supplementation can be a good way to keep your folate levels topped up. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 7956.description_text: The Viridian Tri-Hair System, a comprehensive trio designed to nourish hair from the inside out and moisturise the scalp. Each formulation is designed to support healthier and more vibrant hair. Free massage comb included in the set. Step one - The Hair Support Complex is in a convenient capsule that delivers a synergistic blend of 11 vitamins, minerals, and plant-based phytonutrients. Biotin and selenium help maintain normal hair and skin, copper supports healthy pigmentation, and vitamin C contributes to collagen formation while protecting cells from oxidative stress. Step two - Organic Hair Growth Liquid, a unique oral supplement of carefully cold-pressed organic plant seed oils, including researched organic millet extract and organic evening primrose oil. Naturally rich in essential and polyunsaturated fatty acids, this formula supports normal hair growth while enhancing lustre and shine by strengthening the hair’s protective barrier. Step three - Viridian Hair Restore Serum is a blend of delicate organic plant seed oils, carefully cold-pressed to retain their nutritional quality. Blended with organic essential oils distilled from fresh herbs, including rosemary and lavender. A nourishing blend of argan, evening primrose and safflower oil contributes to hair lustre and shine. This lightweight, non-greasy formula penetrates deeply to replenish moisture, repair damage, and enhance your hair’s natural lustre. This expertly formulated trio works in harmony to support hair health. Containing carefully selected nutrients and minerals with cold-pressed organic plant oils. Tri-Hair System nourishes hair from within, promoting strength and shine. Whether you’re looking to support long-term hair health or revitalise lacklustre hair, the Viridian Tri-Hair box set is a natural and effective solution. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria, including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 7964.description_text: Ionic Magnesium Liquid is sourced from an environmentally pristine area of the Northern shore of the Great Salt Lake in Utah. This source offers a natural and clean environment for the water rich in magnesium and electrolytes to be harvested. It is left without any interference for a further 2 years, as the sodium naturally evaporates, this leaves a concentrated version of liquid magnesium. The fluid is bottled, with nothing else added, just as nature intended. The term ionic confirms that the magnesium is unbound, therefore it is ready to react and be absorbed and utilised by the body. An unbound magnesium has a higher bioavailability and is easily assimilated. Viridian Ionic Magnesium liquid contains naturally occurring electrolytes. Magnesium is an essential mineral and required for normal psychological function. Known as the ‘miracle mineral’ it contributes to normal energy-yielding metabolism and reduction of tiredness and fatigue. Contains 100% active ingredients, formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 7965.description_text: Ceylon or zeylanicum (Cinnamomum verum) has gained attraction in recent years for its potential health benefits, including the maintenance of healthy blood sugar levels. Cinnamon helps maintain normal blood lipid levels and stomach comfort. It is also an excellent alternative to feverfew and helps to maintain comfort in the body and head. Viridian Organic Cinnamon is certified Organic by the Soil Association and formulated with a high potency extract, equivalent to 4800mg of whole bark and providing 60mg of proanthocyanidins. Often referred to as “true cinnamon”, the name “Ceylon” comes from its origin; Sri Lanka, historically known as Ceylon. This has more therapeutic and studied benefits than cassia bark which is the cinnamon often used in cooking. "True cinnamon" was grown in Sri Lanka and around the 17th century sailors crossing the Indian Ocean cultivated the plant in Madagascar. This is one of the few other places in the world to successfully grow true cinnamon outside of Sri Lanka. Overall, true cinnamon not only enriches culinary creations but also offers a range of potential health benefits, making it a valuable addition to both the kitchen and wellness routines. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 7966.description_text: The Viridian One Week No Sugar Challenge has been created to help you cut back on sugar. The combination of a Chromium & Cinnamon Complex alongside a 7 day guide will help you take control of your cravings and break your sugar habits. The programme includes one week’s supply of Chromium & Cinnamon Complex. Chromium is an important mineral that contributes to the maintenance of normal blood glucose levels. This complex is formulated with a high dose of chromium combined with complementary cinnamon and alpha lipoic acid. 7972.description_text: ‘Skye’s mum just isn’t fun anymore. One day, a chance comment lifts them off the sofa and down a road that leads them to gold medals! Join this trash-eating raccoon family on a life-saving journey to health and happiness.’ The narrator is 5-year-old Skye who is desperate to get away from the TV and have fun with mum – but she’s always too tired. ‘My Mum Ran a 5K’ by author Cheryl Thallon aims to inspire children to develop a love of movement and a taste for healthy food early on in life, ultimately helping to instil life-long habits from an early age. It encourages children to become the inspiration and motivators for wellness and good health within their families. This colourful, fully illustrated 36-page publication, is aimed at 3 to 7-year-olds. The book is the work of illustrator Charlie Tomkins, but continues a lifetime mission for Cheryl, who “fell in love” with health food stores aged 21, having worked in the health sector for 40+ years including in health food stores, as editor of Natural Food Trader magazine and finally, as the founder of ethical vitamin company, Viridian Nutrition. For four decades, physical and mental wellness has been her passion. “The big question to my mind has been ‘What kind of 60-year-old do you want to be?’ Well, the habits we have today are direct predictors of the health we will experience in the years ahead. By writing this story for children, maybe the connection between food, movement and health can be sparked. “If we love the NHS, then we must start and continue to love ourselves, making the decision to care for our own health so we can free up hospital beds for those less fortunate than ourselves.” ‘Skye’s mum just isn’t fun anymore. 7975.description_text: Vitamin D3 & K2 is a balanced combination of two essential nutrients. Vitamin D and K contribute to the maintenance of normal bones, and vitamin D also contributes to the maintenance of normal muscle function, normal teeth and the function of the immune system. Vitamin D is often referred to as ‘the sunshine vitamin’ as it is naturally produced under the skin following exposure to sunlight. During winter periods we can’t make vitamin D from sunlight because the sun is too low in the sky. Because it’s difficult to get enough vitamin D from food, Public Health England recommends supplementation of vitamin D to maintain bone and muscle health. This formulation features an advancedform of vegan vitamin D3 that has been plant sourced from lichen and clinically trialled at the University of Surrey. The non-animal tested K2 is naturally derived from fermented natto cultures. Vitamin K contributes to normal blood clotting and can be found in fermented foods and animal products, and is also produced by gut bacteria. Vitamin K2 works synergistically with D3 and these two essential nutrients are in forms which are optimally absorbed by the body. Contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. Sourced according to Viridian’s strict ethical criteria including no animal testing, GMO or palm oil. 7976.description_text: Organic MCT Oil is sourced from 100% organic coconut and certified by the Soil Association. Once harvested the coconuts go through a gentle steam distillation process to extract the medium chain triglycerides which have shown in research to benefit a number of health areas. The delicate oil provides a blend of medium chain triglycerides which are a form of highly digestible oil. MCT oil consists of four medium chain triglycerides; C6 (caproic acid), C8 (caprylic acid), C10 (capric acid) and C12 (Lauric acid). The C8 and C10 carbon chains have been highly researched and concluded to be the most nutritional forms. Viridian MCT oil is formulated to be high in both C8 and C10 fatty acids, creating an effective, nutritional, and pure supplement. The oil has a neutral taste and pleasant texture, which is great for drizzling onto a salad, pouring into a smoothie or adding to a nourishing dip. High levels of homocysteine can lead to various health implications although often there are few symptoms. Consuming foods that are naturally high in B12, B6 and Folate can assist in lowering homocysteine levels and the reduction of homocysteine can support brain and heart health. Homocysteine Support Complex contains 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists with no artificial fillers and no nasties. 7982.description_text: Collagen is the main structural protein of skin, hair, nails, ligaments, and tendons, but did you know, when consumed in the diet, our bodies can’t absorb collagen in its complete form? It is estimated that collagen production slows from the age of 30 and 50% of collagen is lost by the age of 50. 7987.description_text: Vitamin A is a fat-soluble vitamin, essential for many body systems and serves as a building block for living cells. It can be found in eggs and other meat sources. It plays a significant role in maintaining healthy vision. In addition, vitamin A supports normal iron metabolism. It also plays a role in the process of cell specialisation and contributes to the maintenance of normal mucous membranes. Viridian Vitamin A is in the form of retinol acetate, this is easily recognised by the body and quickly converted to retinoic acid. It’s a convenient way to obtain a vegan form of Vitamin A. Retinoic acid is not available from plant sources, therefore vegans are particularly susceptible to being deficient in vitamin A. Unlike food supplements that use retinol palmitate, Viridian Vitamin A is completely palm oil free. A kinder alternative for our planet, whilst delivering the purest and most effective supplements. This one-a-day supplement from Viridian contains the recommended level of folic acid at 400μg per capsule. Folic acid (folate) is a member of the vitamin B complex family which contributes to a reduction in tiredness and fatigue, the normal function of the immune system, normal psychological function, and the processes of normal homocysteine metabolism, amino acid synthesis, cell division and blood formation. 7999.description_text: High potency, great tasting and 100% natural vitamin D3 supplement.Easy-to-use spray presentation of this popular supplement with a great tasting natural orange flavour. Ideal for use on the go, this spray delivers a high potency dose of vitamin D3 which can either be swallowed or absorbed through the soft tissues of the mouth. This makes it ideal for those looking for a pill-free way to increase their daily intake of this essential nutrient. Vitamin D contributes to the maintenance of normal bones, teeth, muscle function and immune function. Vitamin D also contributes to the normal absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus.Vitamin D is often referred to as ‘the sunshine vitamin’ as it is naturally produced under the skin following exposure to sunlight. During winter periods we can’t make vitamin D from sunlight because the sun is too low in the sky. Because it’s difficult to get enough vitamin D from food, Public Health England recommend supplementation of vitamin D to maintain bone and muscle health. Whereas most vitamin D3 supplements on the market are derived from the lanolin in sheep’s wool, Viridian’s Vitamin D3 spray provides vitamin D in a vegan plant-based form derived from lichen. Formulated to deliver an optimal dose, 2 sprays daily provides 2000IU of vitamin D3.
